name: Party Mode
description: Full-screen Party with selectable guest QR, HA-controlled menu categories and native music search.
author: Local Kiosk Satellite project

settings.title: Speaker / højttaler
settings.description: Music Assistant HA media_player for the speaker group whose queue Party should follow.

settings.title: Start automatically when visibility allows
settings.description: Otherwise use Party start/stop actions. Independent of all screensavers and other plugin visibility.

settings.title: Only while playing
settings.description: Also gate Party on the selected speaker playback state.

settings.title: Allow while paused
settings.description: Used when Only while playing is enabled.

settings.title: Visibility entity (optional)
settings.description: Optional Home Assistant entity that controls whether this overlay is allowed to appear.

settings.title: Visibility condition
settings.description: Active recognizes on, true, home, playing, open, detected, occupied and present. Time between does not need an entity.

settings.title: Visibility value
settings.description: Value for the condition. Examples: on, 30, 10..200, or 22:00-06:00.

settings.title: Menu and Close buttons
settings.description: Menu only is the default: no Close icon. All controls is retained for upgrades and also becomes Menu only. Search and playlists have separate permissions. HA actions always work.

settings.title: Volume controls
settings.description: Compact −/+ controls by default, or a slim tinted slider. Independent of playback controls and visualization gain.

settings.title: Show playback controls
settings.description: Show Play/Pause and Stop for the selected MA queue. Independent of the volume slider and Settings/Close buttons.

settings.title: Visualization
settings.description: None / Neon Spectrum / Mirror Spectrum / Radial Pulse / Waveform / Star Particles / Neon Tunnel. Actions can save another choice. Lyrics follows MA song text, synchronized when timecodes exist.

settings.title: Party visualization gain
settings.description: Independent Party visual strength. Does not change audio volume.

settings.title: Party refresh rate
settings.description: Party rendering and audio-frame rate. Independent of the normal spectrum overlay. Eco uses fewer bars, particles and waveform samples.

settings.title: Show MA guest QR
settings.description: Follows MA guest access for the same configured group. Hiding QR does not disable MA guest access.

settings.title: Allow music search
settings.description: Search MA tracks; choose Add to queue or Play now. Independent of Menu/Close visibility.

settings.title: Allow queue tracks to play on tap
settings.description: Tapping previous/upcoming songs starts that queue item immediately. Off locks queue selection.

settings.title: Show Quick Actions above Party
settings.description: Requires Quick Actions 0.2.7+. Each action keeps its own visibility conditions.

settings.title: Playlist and EQ controls
settings.description: Favorites open in a collapsed drawer. EQ choices require the settings menu, an MA admin token and supported Sonos DSP playback.

settings.title: Tracks before current
settings.description: Scrollable queue window. Set both counts to 0 for current song only. HA queue hide/show actions remain available.

settings.title: Tracks after current
settings.description: Scrollable queue window. Set both counts to 0 for current song only. HA queue hide/show actions remain available.

commands.title: Party guest QR: follow Music Assistant (saved)
Party guests: enable access in Music Assistant
Party guests: disable access in Music Assistant
